## Viz 1
```{r}
library(tidyverse); library(lubridate); library(patchwork); library(scales)

meds <- read_csv("medications.csv")
pts  <- read_csv("patients.csv") |> select(Id, BIRTHDATE)

d <- meds |>
  left_join(pts, by = c("PATIENT" = "Id")) |>
  mutate(
    start_date = as_date(START),
    stop_date  = coalesce(as_date(STOP), as_date("2026-10-16")),  # reference date
    age_start  = floor(time_length(interval(BIRTHDATE, start_date), "years")),
    age_stop   = floor(time_length(interval(BIRTHDATE, stop_date),  "years"))
  ) |>
  filter(age_start >= 0, TOTALCOST > 0)

# --- Panel A: avg # of distinct active meds per patient at each age
set.seed(1)
samp <- d |> filter(PATIENT %in% sample(unique(PATIENT), 20000))  # keeps expansion manageable

need <- samp |>
  mutate(age = map2(age_start, pmin(age_stop, 100), seq)) |>
  unnest(age) |>
  group_by(PATIENT, age) |>
  summarise(n_meds = n_distinct(CODE), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(age) |>
  summarise(avg_meds = mean(n_meds))

# --- Panel B: share of cost paid by insurer, by age at prescription
support <- d |>
  filter(age_start <= 100) |>
  group_by(age = age_start) |>
  summarise(cov = sum(PAYER_COVERAGE) / sum(TOTALCOST))

band <- annotate("rect", xmin = 65, xmax = 100, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
                 fill = "#1F3A5F", alpha = 0.08)

p1 <- ggplot(need, aes(age, avg_meds)) + band +
  geom_line(color = "#1F3A5F", linewidth = 1.6) +
  labs(title = "Older patients take more medications...",
       y = "Avg. medications\nper patient", x = NULL)

p2 <- ggplot(support, aes(age, cov)) + band +
  geom_line(color = "#C8553D", linewidth = 1.6) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(title = "...but insurers do not cover a larger share of the cost",
       y = "Share of cost\npaid by insurance", x = "Patient age")

(p1 / p2) +
  plot_annotation(caption = "Source: Synthea synthetic patient dataset (Massachusetts). Shaded area = age 65+.") &
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) &
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
```
